opps.title: Liquor Factory VI Byram — down 12%, your #11 account
opps.body: Still ordering, but 1,399 cases lighter than last year (12%). It is your #11 account and 3.5% of your commission, so the slide is worth about $1,399 in modeled commission. The drop is concentrated in White Claw (-488 cases), Twisted Tea (-219 cases) — a mix problem you can work on the next visit, not a lost account.

opps.title: 5 accounts holding all year but soft this month — 1,771 cases behind
opps.body: Year to date each of these is fine, so the relationship is not the problem — but month to date they are all well behind where they were last August. That is the pattern that becomes a bad quarter if nobody catches it, and it is the cheapest kind to fix: the account is still buying, it just has not placed its usual order yet. Together they are 1,771 cases and about $1,771 of commission behind last August's pace, with days left in the month to close it.

opps.title: Yuengling Lager — 5% of your commission, down 8% YoY
opps.body: Sales are down 1,297 cases (8%) vs last year, but Yuengling Lager is still 5.3% of your total commission — your #6 brand. That decline has already cost about $1,297 in modeled commission, and recovering half of it is worth roughly $648. 32 accounts bought it last year; 33 have this year.

opps.title: 2 brands with real placement gaps — 12 open doors
opps.body: These brands land in far more accounts like yours than they do in your book. The comparison is not raw company share: it weights each brand's on- and off-premise placement rate by your own channel mix, so an on-premise book is never judged against a supermarket brand's reach. Each door below is valued at what a typical account doing business in that brand actually buys company-wide (the median, not an average), scaled down to the size of the doors you actually call on — so these are ordinary placements in YOUR kind of account, not best-case ones in someone else's. Closing every gap would be worth roughly $777 — that is a ceiling, not a forecast, and it compares against $277,379 of commission in your book today. Take the top one or two lines; the whole list is not a year's work.
